title: Hexagonally binned density
intent: Reveal dense two-dimensional clusters by aggregating raw points into fixed-pixel hexagonal bins.

ai.create: Create a responsive hexbin density chart from typed x/y points. Plot may use its hexbin transform; TanStack should use granular d3-hexbin in the resolved manual pixel range and pass inverted bin centers to hexagon.
ai.maintain: Change bin radius and thresholds while keeping the D3 extent synchronized with chart margins, fixed-pixel hexagons, stable bin keys, and cast-free channels.
